// diagnostic

E1338

This loadable library was built by Jet `{artifact_version}`, but the loading program uses Jet `{host_version}`.

What

This loadable library was built by Jet `{artifact_version}`, but the loading program uses Jet `{host_version}`.

Why

A `.jetlib` artifact pins the exact compiler identity that built it (D-LIB-REUSE1=B) — Jet makes no cross-version binary layout promise, so a mismatched artifact is refused before it is mapped, never linked with stale layout assumptions.

Fix

Rebuild the library with the loading program's Jet version, or install a matching Jet toolchain.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1338: tests/ui/jetlib_version_mismatch.stderr.
